title: Workflow Recipe Schema
description: JSON Schema for validating QA automation recipes.

name.description: The name of the automation workflow.

description.description: A description of what this workflow tests or accomplishes.

steps.description: The ordered list of steps to execute.

type.description: The type of automation step to perform.

url.description: The target URL. (For 'goto' steps. Supports {{variable}} syntax)

selector.description: Playwright selector (CSS, XPath, or text) to locate the target element. Optional if 'name' is provided.

isXpath.description: Set to true if using raw CSS or XPath selectors directly. Set to false to use adaptive lookup. Defaults to false.

name.description: The logical field name, label, button text, or placeholder used by the self-healing locator finder to dynamically resolve the element.

value.description: The value to fill or option to select. (For 'fill' and 'selectOption' steps. Supports {{variable}} syntax)

fields.description: List of form fields to fill out. (For 'fillForm' steps)

name.description: The name of the form field, matching its label or control attribute.

selector.description: Optional direct selector override. If omitted, the self-healing engine will find it dynamically.

value.description: Optional hardcoded value or boolean selection. If omitted, a mock value will be auto-generated.

dropdownOptionSelector.description: Selector for the options inside the dropdown wrapper (e.g. standard items, PrimeNG list selectors).

valueType.description: The data format, used for both generated mock data validation and runtime check rules.

required.description: Is this field required? Toggles validation alerts.

inputOptions.description: Advanced parameters for generated mock inputs.

levels.description: Multi-level menu names to navigate to sequentially. (For 'navigateSidebar' steps. E.g. { "first": "Menu", "second": "Submenu" })

urlContains.description: Sub-string matching pattern in network response URL. (For 'waitForResponse' steps)

method.description: HTTP request method. Defaults to POST. (For 'waitForResponse' steps)

statusCode.description: Optional expected HTTP response status code. (For 'waitForResponse' steps)

text.description: Text expected to appear in the viewport. (For 'assertText' steps. Supports {{variable}} syntax)

screenshotName.description: Filename for saving the screen capture. (For 'screenshot' steps)

timeout.description: Timeout threshold in milliseconds for this specific operation.
